I will put chemical fertilizer on this rice plot, but not too much because money is tight and getting inputs is not always easy here. I will try improved seed if I can get it from the agro-dealer, and I will use herbicide because rice weeding takes a lot of work. I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains, and I do not have that kind of water control on this plot. My household will do much of the work, but I will still hire some labor for land preparation and maybe harvesting.
